exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Automated Collection
exploitedBy.relevance: Without sensitivity classification, automated collection of data cannot distinguish between sensitive and non-sensitive data, increasing exposure risk.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Cloud Storage
exploitedBy.relevance: Unclassified data in cloud storage is more vulnerable to unauthorized access as protective controls cannot be applied appropriately.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Lifecycle-Triggered Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Absent retention schedules directly relate to lifecycle-triggered deletion failures, where data is not properly purged at end-of-life.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Information Repositories
exploitedBy.relevance: Data retained indefinitely without schedules remains accessible in repositories, increasing the attack surface for data collection.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Valid Accounts
exploitedBy.relevance: Coarse-grained access controls allow valid accounts to access resources beyond their required scope, enabling lateral movement and data access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Temporary Elevated Cloud Access
exploitedBy.relevance: Inadequate granularity in access controls may allow attackers to exploit temporary elevated cloud access mechanisms.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Conditional Access Policies
exploitedBy.relevance: Insufficient granularity in conditional access policies is a direct manifestation of inadequate access control granularity.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Private Keys
exploitedBy.relevance: Missing encryption at rest exposes private keys and credentials stored on disk to direct access by attackers.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Stored Data Manipulation
exploitedBy.relevance: Without encryption at rest, stored data can be directly manipulated or read by unauthorized parties.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration Over Physical Medium
exploitedBy.relevance: Unencrypted data at rest is especially vulnerable to physical medium exfiltration if storage devices are physically accessed.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Gather Victim Identity Information
exploitedBy.relevance: Without anonymization or pseudonymization, personal identity information is directly exposed and can be gathered by adversaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Purchase Technical Data
exploitedBy.relevance: Non-anonymized personal data can be purchased or obtained by adversaries from breached or leaked datasets.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Transfer Data to Cloud Account
exploitedBy.relevance: Non-compliant cross-border transfers mirror the technique of transferring data to cloud accounts in unauthorized jurisdictions.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data Destruction
exploitedBy.relevance: Insecure disposal relates directly to improper or incomplete data destruction processes that leave residual data recoverable.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: File Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Incomplete data disposal often involves inadequate file deletion methods that do not securely remove data from storage media.
